title: Demo create/edit/mark-opened mutations discard the updated store (`let _ = next`), so model.demo_store stays stale
evidence:
let #(next, eff) =
        demo_api.create_vacancy(
          demo_store_of(model),
          payload,
          "",
          ApiReturnedVacancyCreate,
        )
      let _ = next
      eff
    }
    False ->
      vacancy_api.create_vacancy(  -- and demo_api.gleam:170-173: `pub fn create_vacancy(...) -> #(DemoStore, Effect(msg)) { let #(next, vacancy) = demo_store.create_vacancy(store, payload)  #(next, deliver(on_response, vacancy)) }`
detail: DemoStore is immutable; the mutation's new store is dropped at all four client.gleam demo sites (5959 create, 6161+6275 update, 2537 mark-opened). Created vacancy never reaches the store (dashboard/handoff refetch misses or errors), edits are lost, Submitted→UnderReview is lost — demo create/edit surfaces are broken.
recommended_fix: At each of the four sites return Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next)) instead of `let _ = next`, or route these messages through demo_update which already stores next.

title: Bulk-reject from demo mode fires a real POST — no demo branch and demo_update doesn't intercept
detail: In demo, ?mode=select is parsed regardless of demo_mode and leaderboard_view.gleam:163 renders select_mode_action_bar (on_click UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected); sweep_nudge_banner (application_detail.gleam:144) dispatches UserClickedMarkAllRejected (client.gleam:4841, same unguarded call). Both fall through demo_update to a real bulk_reject_applications POST — demo mode issues a write to a real endpoint.
recommended_fix: Intercept both messages in demo_update.handle and resolve against demo_store (demo_api.bulk_reject_applications exists), or add a demo_mode branch in the update_inner arms.

title: Stripe checkout/consent calls reachable from demo — unlock CTA on unpaid v-harbour and extend button are not demo-guarded
detail: v-harbour is unpaid with one unscored applicant, so the demo renders the unlock CTA; UserClickedPayCheckout is not in demo_update's intercept list and falls through to real payment_api.check_consent then create_checkout (Stripe). Same for UserClickedExtendVacancy (client.gleam:3845, vacancy_detail.gleam:405) → real consent-check/extension checkout. Violates the no-Stripe-from-demo scope guard.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserClickedPayCheckout/UserConfirmedUnlockConsent/UserClickedExtendVacancy (+ extension consent confirm) in demo_update with a demo-safe response (e.g. toast or mock unlock against the store).

title: Refresh/direct load on a demo edit URL (/vacancies/v-*/edit) enters demo but never fetches edit data — blank edit form
detail: is_demo_route matches VacancyEdit("v-*") so init's enter_demo runs, but demo_entry_effects has no VacancyEdit arm (`_ -> []`) and enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading/vacancy_edit_id; modem.init doesn't dispatch at boot. The edit page renders an empty form and saving targets vacancy id "" in the store.
recommended_fix: Add a VacancyEdit arm to demo_entry_effects (set vacancy_edit_loading/id via enter_demo and call demo_api.get_for_edit), or exclude VacancyEdit from is_demo_route.

title: Typed /settings and /billing URLs in demo keep demo_mode=True and fire real settings_api calls (profile save writes mock data)
detail: Demo exit only resets for is_public_route; Settings/Billing stay in demo mode and handle_browser_change's Billing branch fires a real fetch_billing_history, while the settings page's UserSubmittedProfile/password-change/delete-account arms fall through demo_update to real settings_api writes. With a live session cookie present, saving overwrites the real landlord profile with mock demo data.
recommended_fix: Treat Settings/Billing as demo exits (add to the exit-path reset) or add demo_mode guards to the Billing nav branch and the settings write handlers.

title: Demo exit discards a pre-existing real session (auth: NotAsked) with no session re-check
evidence:
True ->
              handle_browser_change(
                Model(
                  ..model,
                  demo_mode: False,
                  demo_store: None,
                  auth: NotAsked,
                ),
                uri,
                route,
              )  -- and demo_update.gleam UserClickedLogout: `#(Model(..model, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None, auth: NotAsked, route: routes.Landing, toasts: []), modem.push("/", None, None))`
detail: A logged-in landlord who navigates to /demo has auth replaced by the mock; on exit auth is set to NotAsked and no check_session is re-dispatched, so they land on a logged-out-looking landing page despite a valid session cookie until a manual refresh.
recommended_fix: On demo exit, dispatch auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession) when the browser may hold a real session, or preserve the prior auth value across demo entry/exit.

title: In-flight live payment polling survives enter_demo and fires real get_payment_status inside demo; ?payment=success branch also unguarded in demo
detail: A live payment poll (5s timer) started before entering /demo keeps firing: AppPolledPaymentStatus falls through demo_update and update_inner's guard (payment_polling == Some) still passes, issuing a real GET from demo. Likewise handle_browser_change's ?payment=success/?extended=success branches schedule real polls/pixel calls when demo_mode is True.
recommended_fix: Clear payment_polling/checkout state in enter_demo and/or intercept AppPolledPaymentStatus in demo_update; skip the payment-success query-param branches when model.demo_mode is True.
